evidence: Changes mempool acceptance policy in src/validation.cpp, src/policy/packages.h, and adds functional tests in test/functional/mempool_sigoplimit.py.
rationale: Fixes integer overflow and debug assertion failures during mempool transaction staging. An incoming transaction with high sigops could exceed INT32_MAX in sigop-adjusted weight and abort debug builds on Assume(feerate.size > 0) because staging ran before standard sigop verification.
